title: El Sayed addresses RNC event spotlight: 'The barbarian is in the White House'
text:
Michigan Democratic Senate candidate Abdul el Sayed addressed the attention he received at last week’s Republican midterm elections convention on Sunday.

While speaking with CBS News’s Weijia Jiang on Face the Nation, the socialist Senate candidate said President Donald Trump, Vice President JD Vance, and other speakers who mentioned him at the first-of-its-kind convention in Dallas didn’t address the real issues voters are facing.
